title: OK when it works…
body: The remote terminal and saved scripts features are great when they work… but getting and keeping this app connected to a server - especially unRaid - is a tragic mess. Maybe this is designed for something else, some specific server type I’m not familiar with. But it is unreasonably difficult to set up and even if you do get it connected, it’s slow and fragile. It takes forever to load data about dockers and VMs, presumably because it’s doing some query in the background that is general enough to work in most places but therefore not specific enough to be fast or native to anything. This is barely functional.

title: One of the most secured SSH app
body: Been using this daily as my SSH client for managing a handful of servers. What sold me is the ML-KEM post-quantum key exchange support — most SSH tools haven’t caught up on this yet, so it’s nice to see a mobile app taking future-proofing seriously. On top of that, the developer is genuinely responsive. Monitoring dashboard is clean and functional too. Easy 5 stars — rare to find both solid crypto and active development in one app.
